SELECT count(*) FROM student
and name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and clazz like concat('%',#{clazz},'%')
and student_id like concat('%',#{id},'%')
AND phone = #{phone}

SELECT s.device_id, s.grade, s.img as image, p.name as parentName, s.student_id, t.name as teacherName, s.clazz, s.name, s.password, s.phone, s.sex, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.status, s.birth, t.teacher_id as teacherId, p.parent_id as parentId FROM student s JOIN teacher t ON s.teacher_id = t.teacher_id JOIN parent p ON s.parent_id = p.parent_id
